## Why This Analysis

This post summarizes an integrated liver omics analysis in female mice carrying
Rps2-A226Y, comparing mutant versus wildtype at two corrected ages: **9 months**
and **15 months**.

The workflow combines differential transcriptomics and metabolomics to identify
pathway-level progression across time, with emphasis on bile acid metabolism,
oxidative stress, lipid remodeling, and protein quality control pathways.

## Data Note

The original source file names contain "6m" and "12m", but the corrected cohort
labels used for interpretation are **9m** and **15m**.

## Main Biological Takeaways

1. The mutant phenotype is progressive from 9m to 15m across both omics layers.
2. Bile acid pathway dysregulation strengthens with age and remains a dominant signature.
3. Stress-adaptation programs appear stronger earlier, with altered regulatory balance later.
4. Lipid and antioxidant pathway changes support age-dependent metabolic remodeling.
5. Most strongly significant features preserve direction across time, with selective switches.
6. Sphingomyelin species accumulate broadly, consistent with a chain-length-dependent
   ceramide synthase (Cers2/Cers4) shift toward the SM-conversion arm of the pathway.
7. Lysosomal genes, especially cathepsins, are broadly downregulated alongside XIAP
   upregulation, consistent with a lysosome-linked anti-apoptotic adaptation.
8. Pre-ranked GSEA (fgsea + MSigDB) independently recovers bile acid metabolism and
   proteasome/protein-degradation signatures among the top pathways.
9. Gene-metabolite concordance is not uniform across pathways: some (amino acid,
   purine/pyrimidine) agree in direction, while bile acid and lipid pathways show
   more disagreement worth further investigation.
10. A database-driven enrichment cross-check (SMPDB via MetaboAnalystR) is only weakly
    informative here: roughly 20% of measured metabolites appear in SMPDB, and that
    subset is biased against lipids. Correcting the statistical background from the
    pathway library to the measured metabolome weakens every contrast by about an order
    of magnitude, leaving no FDR-significant pathway at either age.
11. What remains is a nominal, uncorrected tendency toward depletion of TCA-adjacent
    intermediates and carnitine at 9 months, driven by a small overlapping metabolite set.
